svg.title: What Sheets can do
svg.desc: Your .xlsx stays .xlsx: Opens and saves Excel workbooks, CSV and TSV. Nothing to import, nothing to export.; ~490 Excel functions: XLOOKUP, FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, LET and SUMIFS, with autocomplete and argument hints.; Charts & PivotTables: Seven chart types that follow your data, and PivotTable summaries built from live formulas.; AutoFill & Flash Fill: Drag to continue a series, switch with AutoFill Options, or press Ctrl+E to fill from an example.; The shortcuts you know: Ctrl+D, F4, Ctrl+Shift+L, Alt KeyTips and the rest of Excel’s keyboard. F1 lists them all.; AutoRecover every 30 s: Every workbook, saved or not. After a crash, a recovery screen brings your work back.; Version history: Each save keeps the previous version, and “Don’t Save” can be undone for 7 days.; Check Workbook: Lists formula errors, inconsistent formulas and totals that skip rows, on every sheet.; Updates itself: When a new version is out, an Update button appears in the title bar. One click installs it.
